views.listing_fee_totals:
SELECT a.product_id,
    sum(r.amount) AS cumulative_confirmed_fee
   FROM listing_fee_receipts r
     JOIN listing_fee_charges c USING (charge_id)
     JOIN listing_fee_assessments a USING (assessment_id)

views.reputation_summary:
SELECT u.user_id,
    COALESCE(r.average_stars, 0::numeric) AS average_stars,
    COALESCE(r.review_count, 0::bigint) AS review_count,
    COALESCE(p.penalty_points, 0::bigint) AS penalty_points,
        CASE
            WHEN r.review_count IS NULL THEN NULL::numeric
            ELSE r.average_stars - COALESCE(p.penalty_points, 0::bigint)::numeric
        END AS reputation
   FROM users u
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT rv.reviewee_id,
            avg(rv.rating) AS average_stars,
            count(*) AS review_count
           FROM reviews rv
             JOIN orders o USING (order_id)
          WHERE rv.deleted_at IS NULL AND (rv.reviewer_id = o.buyer_id AND rv.reviewee_id = o.seller_id OR rv.reviewer_id = o.seller_id AND rv.reviewee_id = o.buyer_id) AND (o.workflow_model::text = 'UC83'::text AND o.valid_delivered_at IS NOT NULL OR o.workflow_model::text = 'LEGACY_V14'::text AND (o.status::text = ANY (ARRAY['DELIVERED'::character varying::text, 'COMPLETED'::character varying::text])))
          GROUP BY rv.reviewee_id) r ON r.reviewee_id = u.user_id
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT penalty_ledger.user_id,
            sum(penalty_ledger.points_delta) AS penalty_points
           FROM penalty_ledger
          GROUP BY penalty_ledger.user_id) p ON p.user_id = u.user_id;

views.case_cleanup_candidates:
SELECT case_id,
    last_related_completion_at + '7 days'::interval AS cleanup_due_at
   FROM cases c
  WHERE (state::text = ANY (ARRAY['CLOSED'::character varying::text, 'REJECTED'::character varying::text])) AND last_related_completion_at IS NOT NULL AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM money_holds h
          WHERE h.case_id = c.case_id AND h.closed_at IS NULL)) AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM order_fund_components f
          WHERE f.order_id = c.order_id AND (f.reserved_amount <> 0::numeric OR (f.refunded_amount + f.released_amount) < f.confirmed_amount))) AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM shipments s
          WHERE s.return_case_id = c.case_id AND (s.status::text <> ALL (ARRAY['DELIVERED'::character varying::text, 'CANCELLED'::character varying::text, 'RETURNED'::character varying::text]))));
views.listing_revenue_entries:
SELECT r.receipt_id,
    a.product_id,
    a.revision_id,
    a.policy_id,
    a.assessment_id,
    r.amount,
    r.confirmed_at
   FROM listing_fee_receipts r
     JOIN listing_fee_charges c USING (charge_id)

views.completed_case_statistics:
SELECT c.case_id,
    c.case_type,
    c.order_id,
    c.closed_at,
    d.outcome,
    d.goods_refund_amount
   FROM cases c
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT decision.outcome,
            decision.goods_refund_amount
           FROM case_decisions decision
             JOIN case_rounds round USING (round_id)
          WHERE round.case_id = c.case_id AND decision.is_final
          ORDER BY decision.decided_at DESC, decision.decision_id DESC
         LIMIT 1) d ON true
  WHERE c.state::text = ANY (ARRAY['CLOSED'::character varying::text, 'REJECTED'::character varying::text]);
views.direct_handover_attention:
SELECT shipment_id,
    order_id,
    leg,
        CASE
            WHEN (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM handover_confirmations h
              WHERE h.shipment_id = s.shipment_id AND h.outcome::text = 'FAILED'::text)) THEN 'CONFLICT_KTV'::text
            ELSE 'SILENT_14_DAYS'::text
        END AS reason
   FROM shipments s
  WHERE workflow_model::text = 'UC83'::text AND delivery_method::text <> 'CARRIER'::text AND valid_delivery_at IS NULL AND ((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM handover_confirmations h
          WHERE h.shipment_id = s.shipment_id AND h.outcome::text = 'FAILED'::text)) OR (initiated_at + '14 days'::interval) <= clock_timestamp() AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM handover_confirmations h
          WHERE h.shipment_id = s.shipment_id)));

functions.og_close_case_holds:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.og_close_case_holds()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', '$user', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    UPDATE money_holds SET closed_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE case_id=(SELECT r.case_id FROM case_rounds r
        WHERE r.round_id=NEW.round_id) AND closed_at IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cases c
        WHERE c.case_id=money_holds.case_id AND c.state IN ('CLOSED','REJECTED'));
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
functions.og_guard_fee_policy:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.og_guard_fee_policy()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', '$user', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF TG_OP='DELETE' OR ROW(NEW.policy_code,NEW.threshold_amount,NEW.fixed_below,NEW.rate_at_or_above,
        NEW.effective_from,NEW.created_by) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.policy_code,OLD.threshold_amount,
        OLD.fixed_below,OLD.rate_at_or_above,OLD.effective_from,OLD.created_by)
        OR NEW.effective_until IS NULL OR NEW.effective_until<=clock_timestamp()
        OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM listing_fee_assessments WHERE policy_id=OLD.policy_id AND assessed_at>=NEW.effective_until) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Keep fee policy history; end policy in the future and create a successor' USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
functions.og_guard_quick_auth:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.og_guard_quick_auth()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', '$user', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ekyc_profiles p JOIN ekyc_decisions d USING(profile_id)
        JOIN ekyc_private_assets a ON a.profile_id=p.profile_id
        WHERE p.profile_id=NEW.profile_id AND p.state='VERIFIED' AND d.outcome='VERIFIED'
          AND a.asset_id=NEW.reference_asset_id AND a.asset_type='REFERENCE' AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
          AND NEW.expires_at<=LEAST(a.expires_at,p.reference_expires_at)
          AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ekyc_profiles pending WHERE pending.user_id=NEW.user_id
                         AND pending.state IN ('DRAFT','IN_PROGRESS','PENDING'))) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Quick auth requires current approved private reference' USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
functions.og_guard_ekyc_snapshot:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.og_guard_ekyc_snapshot()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF TG_OP='DELETE' OR (TG_OP='UPDATE' AND (
        ROW(NEW.profile_id,NEW.user_id,NEW.revision_no,NEW.created_at) IS DISTINCT FROM
        ROW(OLD.profile_id,OLD.user_id,OLD.revision_no,OLD.created_at)
        OR (OLD.state IN ('PENDING','VERIFIED','REJECTED','EXPIRED') AND
            ROW(NEW.submitted_data,NEW.ai_summary,NEW.document_digest,NEW.submitted_at) IS DISTINCT FROM
            ROW(OLD.submitted_data,OLD.ai_summary,OLD.document_digest,OLD.submitted_at))
        OR (OLD.state IN ('VERIFIED','REJECTED','EXPIRED') AND NEW.state<>OLD.state
            AND NOT (OLD.state='VERIFIED' AND NEW.state='EXPIRED')))) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'eKYC identity/submitted evidence is immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
functions.og_guard_grant_history:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.og_guard_grant_history()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF TG_OP='DELETE' OR ROW(NEW.grant_id,NEW.revision_id,NEW.user_id,NEW.source,NEW.issued_by,NEW.reason,
        NEW.granted_at,NEW.expires_at,NEW.command_key) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.grant_id,OLD.revision_id,OLD.user_id,
        OLD.source,OLD.issued_by,OLD.reason,OLD.granted_at,OLD.expires_at,OLD.command_key)
        OR OLD.state<>'AVAILABLE' OR NEW.state NOT IN ('REDEEMED','REVOKED')
        OR (NEW.state='REDEEMED' AND pg_trigger_depth()<2) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Voucher ownership/history cannot be restored after use' USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.og_guard_handover_party()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', '$user', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shipments s JOIN orders o USING(order_id)
        WHERE s.shipment_id=NEW.shipment_id AND s.workflow_model='UC83'
          AND s.delivery_method IN ('SELF_PICKUP','SELF_DELIVERY')
          AND NEW.user_id=CASE NEW.party WHEN 'BUYER' THEN o.buyer_id ELSE o.seller_id END) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Handover confirmation must belong to correct order party' USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END;

functions.og_guard_seller_snapshot:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.og_guard_seller_snapshot()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF TG_OP='DELETE' OR NEW.user_id<>OLD.user_id OR NEW.revision_no<OLD.revision_no
        OR (OLD.state IN ('APPROVED','REJECTED') AND NEW.revision_no=OLD.revision_no AND
            ROW(NEW.state,NEW.ekyc_profile_id,NEW.quick_auth_result_id,NEW.pickup_address_id,NEW.bank_snapshot)
            IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.state,OLD.ekyc_profile_id,OLD.quick_auth_result_id,OLD.pickup_address_id,OLD.bank_snapshot))
        OR (NEW.revision_no>OLD.revision_no AND (NEW.revision_no<>OLD.revision_no+1 OR NEW.state NOT IN ('PENDING_EKYC','PENDING_REVIEW'))) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Seller snapshot changes require a new review revision' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END;

functions.og_guard_checkout_snapshot:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.og_guard_checkout_snapshot()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF TG_TABLE_NAME='checkout_groups' THEN
        IF TG_OP='DELETE' OR (to_jsonb(NEW)-'state') IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-'state') THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Checkout command, amount and deadline are immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    ELSIF OLD.workflow_model='UC83' AND (TG_OP='DELETE' OR
        ROW(NEW.workflow_model,NEW.group_id,NEW.checkout_group_id,NEW.buyer_id,NEW.seller_id,NEW.subtotal,
            NEW.shipping_fee,NEW.total_amount,NEW.voucher_discount_amount,NEW.shipping_discount_amount,
            NEW.points_discount_amount,NEW.return_allowed,NEW.delivery_method,NEW.carrier_snapshot,NEW.handover_day,
            NEW.payment_due_at,NEW.created_at,NEW.shipping_recipient_name,NEW.shipping_phone_number,NEW.shipping_province,
            NEW.shipping_district,NEW.shipping_ward,NEW.shipping_detail_address)

functions.og_guard_listing_activation:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.og_guard_listing_activation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', '$user', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF NEW.workflow_model='UC83' AND NEW.status='ACTIVE' THEN
        IF NEW.current_revision_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.public_revision_id OR NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM product_revisions r JOIN listing_fee_assessments a USING(revision_id)
            WHERE r.revision_id=NEW.public_revision_id AND r.product_id=NEW.product_id AND r.provenance='UC83'
              AND r.listed_unit_price=NEW.listed_price AND r.quantity=NEW.quantity_total
              AND r.return_allowed IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.return_allowed
              AND r.delivery_options=NEW.delivery_options
              AND (a.amount_due=0 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM listing_fee_receipts receipt
                  JOIN listing_fee_charges c USING(charge_id) WHERE c.assessment_id=a.assessment_id))
        ) OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM seller_profiles s JOIN seller_profile_decisions d USING(seller_profile_id)
            WHERE s.user_id=NEW.seller_id AND s.state='APPROVED' AND d.revision_no=s.revision_no
              AND d.outcome='APPROVED') OR NOT og_has_role(NEW.seller_id,'SELLER') THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'ACTIVE requires current KTV approval, confirmed listing fee and seller approval'
                USING ERRCODE='23514';
        END IF;
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END;

functions.og_guard_auth_challenge_history:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.og_guard_auth_challenge_history()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF TG_OP='DELETE' OR ROW(NEW.challenge_id,NEW.user_id,NEW.subject_key,NEW.purpose,NEW.code_digest,
        NEW.issued_at,NEW.expires_at,NEW.next_send_at,NEW.max_attempts,NEW.command_key) IS DISTINCT FROM
        ROW(OLD.challenge_id,OLD.user_id,OLD.subject_key,OLD.purpose,OLD.code_digest,OLD.issued_at,
        OLD.expires_at,OLD.next_send_at,OLD.max_attempts,OLD.command_key)
        OR OLD.state<>'OPEN' OR NEW.attempt_count<OLD.attempt_count
        OR (NEW.state='CONSUMED' AND (NEW.attempt_count<>OLD.attempt_count+1
            OR OLD.attempt_count>=OLD.max_attempts OR clock_timestamp()>=OLD.expires_at
            OR NEW.consumed_at<OLD.issued_at OR NEW.consumed_at>=OLD.expires_at)) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Challenge deadline/digest/consumption history retained' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END;

functions.og_validate_order_workflow_proof:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.og_validate_order_workflow_proof()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', '$user', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE o orders;
BEGIN
    SELECT * INTO STRICT o FROM orders WHERE order_id=NEW.order_id;
    IF o.workflow_model='UC83' AND (
        (o.paid_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM payment_allocations a
            JOIN payment_confirmations c USING(confirmation_id) WHERE a.order_id=o.order_id
                AND c.disposition='ALLOCATABLE' AND c.confirmed_at=o.paid_confirmed_at)
            AND NOT (o.total_amount=0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM zero_checkout_confirmations z
                WHERE z.group_id=o.group_id AND z.buyer_id=o.buyer_id AND z.confirmed_at=o.paid_confirmed_at)))
        OR (o.valid_delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shipments s WHERE s.order_id=o.order_id
            AND s.leg='OUTBOUND' AND s.valid_delivery_at=o.valid_delivered_at))
        OR (o.early_completed_at IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_events e WHERE e.order_id=o.order_id
            AND e.actor_id=o.buyer_id AND e.event_type='EARLY_COMPLETION_ACCEPTED'))
        OR (o.seller_accept_due_at IS NOT NULL AND o.seller_accept_due_at<>
            COALESCE(o.paid_confirmed_at,o.created_at)+INTERVAL '2 days')) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Order deadlines/payment/delivery/consent need source proof' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    RETURN NULL;
END;
